justification: Inspected `javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/ast/type/Type.java`, `ClassOrInterfaceType.java`, `ReferenceType.java`, `ArrayType.java`, `IntersectionType.java`, `PrimitiveType.java`, `TypeParameter.java`, `UnionType.java`, `UnknownType.java`, `VarType.java`, `VoidType.java`, `WildcardType.java`, and `ConvertibleToUsage.java`. The package has 12 production types/interfaces and about 2,898 LOC total, but they form one cohesive Java type-AST hierarchy centered on `Type` and its subtypes, all modeling type syntax/resolution rather than mixing unrelated responsibilities; I found no evidence of a broad, decomposed-into-many-domains God Component.
